name: Maloti-Drakensberg Park
description: This mountain park straddles the border between Lesotho and South Africa, where the Drakensberg rises in basalt walls and golden sandstone cliffs, with arches, caves and rock pools. Thaba Ntlenyana, at 3,482 metres, is its highest peak. Vultures and rare endemic plants live here. Its rock shelters hold the largest concentration of San paintings in Africa south of the Sahara, made over 4,000 years.
